status: additional investigation after disclosed Yeast null; all planned settings reported
selection: largest whole-tie observed calibration threshold under 0.95 times reporting cap and row floor; include accept-all if it meets calibration constraints
uncertainty: 4000 paired resamples; Delicious examples, Bike days; marginal 95% and familywise 98.75% intervals for two coverage differences across two primary dataset comparisons
primary_contrast: demand minus row; primary Delicious threshold .5

delicious.split: seeded row permutation 60 percent fit,20 percent calibration,20 percent test; parse test labels only after model/threshold freeze
delicious.classifier: one-vs-rest LogisticRegression solver liblinear C=1 max_iter=2000, no class weighting; provided binary features; threshold .5 primary and .2 secondary
delicious.estimated_loss: sum of 1-p over predicted positive labels

bike.split: seeded day-group permutation 40 percent predictor fit,20 percent error-head fit,20 percent calibration,20 percent test
bike.predictor: LightGBM quantile alpha=.5, 200 trees,31 leaves, min_child_samples=30, learning_rate=.05
bike.heads: Poisson mean on predictor-fit rows; squared-error absolute-loss head on disjoint error-head rows, same tree settings
bike.scope: retrospective conditional prediction using contemporaneous weather, not operational future-weather forecasting
